record: The frozen production schema the forward-migration checks are run against. Captured read-only on 2026-11-23 by the capture-production-baseline workflow (run 45275716781, artifact production-baseline-10) because the 2026-11-15 snapshot no longer described the database: production has public.resolve_product_classification and public.unit_group_for_base and the snapshot did not, which made 0326's proof fail against the ruler instead of against production. It is a full logical dump (COPY-format data, all schemas including storage and auth) and DOES contain real rows, so it lives only in gitignored backups/; the verification tool loads its schema and skips every data statement. The paired read-only fingerprint is backups/fingerprint-production-2026-11-23T22-04-08.json (32 tables, 325 rows). The same-day nightly backup (run 45273966448) is the restore-verified copy of the same state: 278/278 functions, every count and digest matching.
dataNote: Measured with the project splitter: 1689 statements total, 128 of them data (COPY rows, all skipped, never executed). The loader also skips scaffold/extension/stub statements — see scripts/lib/baseline.mjs. Contains personal data and password hashes — never commit, never publish. The tool re-measures this count and refuses the record if it does not match.

ledgerOnServer.note: The server's own supabase_migrations bookkeeping at capture time: 118 rows, latest `0324`. The repository directory is ahead (the OTA work reaches 0334), and that divergence is exactly why batches are verified against a frozen baseline instead of replaying history.

policy.note: No migration file from supabase/migrations may be replayed onto production as history. Production moves only by individually verified NEW files (0303+), at the release gate, through the sanctioned path.
